test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The singer complained to the police that she was __purportedly__ attacked back stage immediately after the concert.
solution: The correct answer is '**Impossibly**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Purportedly**' is '**Impossibly**'. • **Purportedly** - claimed or believed to be true, but with some doubt or uncertainty. (दावा किया या माना जाता है कि यह सच है, लेकिन कुछ संदेह या अनिश्चितता के साथ) • *Example sentence: The email **purportedly** came from the company's CEO, but we suspect it might be a phishing scam.* • **Impossibly** - in a way that is not possible or feasible. (एक तरह से जो संभव नहीं है) • *Example sentence: It would be **impossibly** difficult to finish this project on time without additional resources.* **Correct Answer:__** *Impossibly.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Maliciously** - (दुर्भावनापूर्वक) - with the intention of causing harm or damage. • **Dramatically** - (नाटकीय ढंग से) - in a way that is theatrical or strikingly noticeable. • **Severely** - (कठोरता से) - in a way that is extremely strict, harsh or intense. 19d:T7c2, The correct answer is **'The students usually asks'.**
